source_name: Bankart – Flik instant payments merchant/integration documentation
why_relevant: Flik is the national instant-payment scheme; Bankart's e-commerce/POS integration guidelines and Flik Connect API documentation carry scheme rules and integration deadlines relevant to fintech acquirers and merchants.

source_name: ESMA – MiCA register of authorised CASPs and white papers
why_relevant: EU-level authoritative register fed by ATVP/BS; the fastest cross-check on how many and which SI CASPs and EMT issuers are authorised, and on new SI entries (e.g. a SI EMI appearing on the EMT list).

source_name: EBA – public registers (PSD2 payment institutions/EMIs; MiCA ART/EMT issuers)
why_relevant: EU-wide register layer for SI-licensed PIs/EMIs and for EMT/ART issuers, enabling passporting analysis (which SI EMIs operate cross-border and which EEA firms passport into SI).

source_name: Blockchain Alliance Europe (SI crypto industry association)
why_relevant: Slovenian-based industry association representing blockchain/crypto companies; advises government on legal-financial frameworks, runs events and publishes member lists — a lobbying-position and actor-map source distinct from bank associations.

source_name: SBCA – Slovenian Blockchain Association
why_relevant: Second SI blockchain/crypto representative body; useful for triangulating industry positions on MiCA implementation and tax proposals and for discovering smaller SI crypto actors.

source_name: Paywiser d.o.o. – SI-licensed EMI corporate/regulatory pages
why_relevant: One of the most visible SI-licensed EMIs (BS licence, EEA passport, UK FCA licence). Its terms & conditions, regional and product pages disclose licence scope, scheme memberships and compliance changes ahead of register updates.

source_name: Incrementum d.o.o. – SI CASP authorisation announcements
why_relevant: One of the few SI firms holding an ATVP MiCA CASP authorisation; company announcements date the licence and describe permitted services — useful primary-firm evidence and a template for tracking the other SI CASPs.

source_name: Enable Banking – Open Banking specifics: Slovenia (market documentation)
why_relevant: Aggregator documentation summarising SI ASPSP API quirks, auth flows (redirect, SCA methods) and per-bank coverage; a fast structural map of the SI open-banking API landscape and its change points.

source_name: Open Banking Tracker – Slovenia country and provider pages
why_relevant: Pointer directory enumerating SI ASPSPs and their developer-portal URLs; good for discovering smaller banks/savings banks' API programmes we would otherwise miss.

source_name: Tax-Fin-Lex – Slovenian finance/tax law news and legislative tracking
why_relevant: Specialist SI legal-financial publisher that reports government adoption of bills (e.g. ZIUTK MiCA implementing act) with dates and article-level detail — an efficient tripwire for regulatory milestones affecting fintech/crypto.

source_name: Bloomberg Adria SI / Delo – crypto and fintech regulatory reporting
why_relevant: SI business media reporting on MiCA authorisation outcomes and on market attrition among SI crypto providers (reported collapse from ~35 providers to a handful post-transition); gives dates and named firms to verify in registers.

source_name: ZMOS / interest-association consultation responses on payment-means law
why_relevant: Shows the non-bank stakeholder response channel and internal deadlines for the July 2026 draft Act on accessibility and use of payment means (cash right, free basic payment package) — a payments-policy file with direct implications for fintech and card acceptance.

source_name: Bizi.si – SI company registry data on fintech/EMI entities
why_relevant: Commercial mirror of AJPES company data; resolves legal names, ownership and status of small SI EMIs/CASPs (e.g. DINARO d.o.o.) that only appear as bare names in regulator registers.

source_name: PISRS – Zbirka: Register pravnih aktov EU (Slovenian national transposition register)
why_relevant: Official national register mapping EU legal acts (title, CELEX, OJ reference, responsible Slovenian ministry/authority, validity dates, transposition deadline, Eurovoc descriptors) to the Slovenian instruments that transpose or implement them. This is the single best national transposition table for banking/payments directives (PSD2/PSD3, CRD, DORA, AMLD) and gives deadline data first-party.

source_name: PISRS Developer API (swagger)
why_relevant: Documented programmatic access to the Slovenian legal information system, including regulations and (per PISRS structure) the EU-acts register — enables deterministic, low-friction long-term collection of transposition and consolidated-text metadata instead of scraping.

source_name: EUR-Lex – National transposition measures (NIM) collection
why_relevant: EU-side authoritative index of Member State measures notified as transposing a directive. For any banking/payments directive the 'National transposition' tab lists the Slovenian instruments (ZBan, ZPlaSSIED, ZPPDFT etc.) with notification dates, letting you detect late or partial transposition.

source_name: EUR-Lex Slovenian-language (SL) act versions and legislative summaries
why_relevant: Official Slovenian-language texts and plain-language summaries of EU banking/payments acts (SEPA Regulation, PSD2, Instant Payments Regulation 2024/886). Provides the exact SL terminology used by Slovenian implementing law — essential as the translation layer for glossary building and for matching national texts to EU acts.

source_name: N-Lex – gateway to Slovenian national law (with EU machine translation layer)
why_relevant: Commission-run single entry point into the Slovenian national database (PIS), with cross-country simultaneous search and automatic translation into other EU languages. Acts as the translation/aggregation layer for analysts without Slovene, and documents the structure and coverage of the Slovenian national collection.

source_name: Državni zbor RS – Predlogi zakonov (bill tracker, EPA-numbered)
why_relevant: Parliamentary stage-by-stage tracker for banking/payments bills after consultation closes, keyed by EPA number, with readings, amendments and adoption dates. Complements PISRS by exposing the timeline between draft and Official Gazette publication.

source_name: OPSI – Odprti podatki Slovenije (national open data portal), dataset 'Predlogi zakonov'
why_relevant: Machine-readable mirror of parliamentary bill data and, more broadly, the national open-data catalogue where government and supervisory datasets (registers, reporting outputs) are published under reuse licences — the lowest-friction structured entry point for archival collection.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Seznam predpisov / Regulation list (supervisory rulebook index)
why_relevant: The supervisor's own consolidated index of applicable regulations and its own sklepi/guidelines, thematically grouped (e.g. internal governance). Serves as the authoritative mapping from EU act to the Slovenian supervisory instrument implementing it, and as the crawl seed for archival snapshots of superseded versions.

source_name: EBA Reporting frameworks / DPM taxonomy releases
why_relevant: Upstream authority for the reporting taxonomy that Banka Slovenije re-publishes. Framework 4.2 final technical package released 25 Nov 2025, applicable from Dec 2025, completing DPM 2.0; mandatory xBRL-CSV switch postponed to 31 Mar 2026; hotfix issued Jan 2026. Gives forward-looking deadline signals for Slovenian banks months ahead of national notices.

source_name: EBA Interactive Single Rulebook
why_relevant: Consolidated view of CRR/CRD/PSD and their level-2/level-3 instruments article by article, letting you resolve which delegated/implementing acts and guidelines attach to any provision a Slovenian instrument transposes. Explicitly a documentation tool with no legal effect — always confirm against EUR-Lex.

source_name: ESRB – National policy / Macroprudential Measures Database
why_relevant: Cross-country database of current AND past national macroprudential measures notified under CRD V/CRR II — capital buffers (CCoB, CCyB, SRB, O-SII), borrower-based measures and reciprocation. For Slovenia it is the durable archive of measures whose original Banka Slovenije announcement pages get superseded, plus notification/application dates.

source_name: Single Market and Competitiveness Scoreboard – Transposition (Slovenia country pages, incl. archived editions)
why_relevant: Quantifies Slovenia's transposition deficit and outstanding directives against the 0.5% target, and links to infringement action for late/incorrect transposition. Useful leading indicator that a banking/payments directive is running late in Slovenia. The site retains an archive of older editions and per-Member-State PDFs.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine + CDX Server API (applied to Slovenian regulator domains)
why_relevant: The recovery layer for this cell: querying the CDX index for bsi.si, atvp.si, e-uprava.gov.si, gov.si/mf and uradni-list.si returns every captured URL with timestamp, MIME type, digest and HTTP status — which recovers withdrawn consultations, superseded sklepi and deleted deadline notices that first-party sites remove. Free, no authentication.

source_name: Tax-Fin-Lex – Register zakonodaje and 'Predpisi v pripravi' / Poročevalec DZ
why_relevant: Commercial Slovenian legal-tax aggregator with a full register of legislation, per-act timelines and all historical versions of amended laws, plus a 'regulations in preparation' collection tracking drafts through the parliamentary Poročevalec. Its version timeline is the fastest way to see how ZBan/ZPlaSSIED evolved with each EU directive.
